roleDescriptions.admin: Full control of the instance: users, groups, settings, logs and organisation resources. The personal resources of other users stay theirs.
roleDescriptions.editor: Creates and shares their own MCP servers, namespaces and endpoints.
roleDescriptions.viewer: Uses what is shared with them. Can create personal API keys.

levelDescriptions.use: Connect through endpoints and the inspector. Configuration is visible without its secrets.
levelDescriptions.edit: Also change the configuration, tools and credentials.
levelDescriptions.manage: Also delete it and choose who has access.

reasons.adminTooltip: You can see and manage this resource because you are an administrator.

source.oidcTooltip: Synced from the identity provider at each sign-in. Removed automatically when the IdP stops sending the group.
source.manualTooltip: Added by an administrator. Never removed by the SSO sync.

ownership.label: Owner
ownership.organizationHelp: Managed by administrators. Only visible to the people and groups you share it with.

organizationKeyHelp: Organisation keys are not tied to a person and only reach namespaces shared with everyone. Prefer personal keys so calls stay attributable.
stdioLocked: The command, arguments and environment of a STDIO server can only be changed by people with the STDIO servers permission (it runs on the MetaMCP host).
endpointAuthRequired: At least one authentication method must stay enabled. Only administrators can publish an endpoint without authentication.

share.title: Share “{{name}}”
share.levelForNew: Access level for new people and groups
share.everyoneHint: Every signed-in user, now and in the future
share.notShared: Not shared yet: only the owner and administrators can see it.
share.readOnlyHint: Only people who manage this resource can see and change who has access.

explain.mcp_server: People who can use this server can add it to their own namespaces and inspect it. They never see its secrets unless they can edit it.
explain.namespace: Sharing a namespace lets people use the tools of its MCP servers through its endpoints, without seeing the servers' credentials.

description.mcp_server: You can use and inspect this MCP server. Ask its owner for edit access to change it.
description.namespace: You can use this namespace through its endpoints. Its servers and tools are configured by its owner.

readOnly.secretsHidden: Environment values, headers and tokens are hidden.

denied.title: This area is restricted
denied.description: Your role does not give you access to this page.
denied.contact: If you need it, ask a MetaMCP administrator.
